## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Verification

List the tests, validation commands, simulation results, or hardware checks performed.

## Safety and compatibility

Describe any effect on physical motion, command limits, shutdown behavior, public APIs, model formats, supported platforms, or existing users. Write `Not applicable` when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the repository's existing style.
- [ ] Tests or validation evidence have been added or updated where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation, examples, and changelog entries have been updated where appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, private robot data, proprietary files, or personal information are included.
- [ ] License, provenance, and third-party notice requirements have been preserved.
- [ ] Hardware-related claims identify the configuration actually tested.
- [ ] Changes capable of affecting physical motion default to a safe state and document remaining risks.
